title: Network dynamics of positive and negative affect in bipolar disorder
sample_size: 32 adults with bipolar I disorder and 36 healthy control participants
limitations: - Network analyses assume stationarity; - Affect ratings collected only once per day; - Sample size limited for subgroup analyses; - No data on neurocognitive or social cognition domains; - Gender differences not examined due to small sample; - Critique of autocorrelation method for critical slowing down
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. The authors mention supplementary materials but do not specify availability of code or data. Preregistration status is not mentioned in the paper.
